meta.tautology_warning: The random-depth control is TAUTOLOGICAL and must not be reported as evidence: A_d IS the counterfactual pair-loss reduction and 'top' is argmax_d A_d, so reduction(top) >= reduction(random) holds by construction. Use top vs uniform/all-depth. Rows carry this in `caveat`.

collab_export.numbers_changed: none -- values are copied verbatim from our internal package
collab_export.labels: `method` is the delivery doc's own name for the arm; `arm_id` keeps our internal label so a cell can still be referred to unambiguously. In the run_manifest files there is no `method` arm column at all: the original `method` there names the INFERENCE SCRIPT FAMILY (sidmlp / nezha / gdn / …), so it is passed through as `decode_family`, and the arm identity is carried by `tag` -> `arm_id` / `doc_name` instead.
collab_export.paths: absolute cluster paths reduced to project-relative; checkpoint / sem_ids / teacher_cache / pop_cache fields reduced to basename
